title: Swimming during a period
answer: Yes, you can swim during your period. Water pressure slows the flow while you are in the water, and swimming is healthy exercise that can even ease cramps. A pad will soak up water and will not work in the water, so many people use a tampon or menstrual cup for swimming. If you do not use these, you might choose to skip swimming on heavy days, and that is okay too. Swimming does not spread infections or harm the water.

Changing your product before exercise and wearing comfortable, close-fitting clothes helps. If your bleeding is very heavy in general, see a health worker.
